_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score is coiling in the mid-band with flat 30d momentum; base rate favors HOLD until a directional breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative supply-focused and silent on phase ladder, so no clean joint directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds ~45-55 and 30d momentum stays flat without CVD/flow break
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed exits 40-62 with a clear 30d momentum expansion or sustained ETF outflow reversal
